jobs.description:
Overview:

**About the company**

Consilio stands as the global leader in eDiscovery, document review, flexible legal talent, and legal advisory & transformation consulting services. With its Consilio Complete suite of capabilities, the company empowers multinational law firms and corporations using innovative software, cost-effective managed services, and deep legal and regulatory industry expertise.

**Overview**

Our ServiceNow Business Analyst (BA) plays a critical role in the successful implementation, customization, and ongoing optimization of the ServiceNow platform. Combining core business analysis expertise with deep platform knowledge, the BA serves as the primary advocate for the internal client (stakeholder) within our organization. They work closely with product owner, internal client (stakeholders), subject matter experts (SMEs), and the development team to lead discussions, gather and clarify requirements, explore alternative solutions, and translate business needs into actionable specifications. Once requirements are defined, the BA partners with product owners, project manager, development manager, and architect to design and develop solutions that meet those needs. Throughout the project lifecycle, the BA remains focused on representing the internal client (stakeholder) vision, facilitating communication across teams, reviewing deliverables for quality and alignment, and ensuring the project stays on track for success.

Responsibilities:

* Requirements Gathering and Analysis
  + Collaborate with stakeholders, users, and departments to identify and understand business needs.
  + Elicit, document, and maintain detailed business and functional requirements, including workflows, use cases, and user stories.
  + Ensure clarity, completeness, and approval of requirements, resolving ambiguities to align business and technical expectations.
* Solution Design and Configuration
  + Translate business needs into functional specifications (Jira Story) for configuration or customization within ServiceNow.
  + Work closely with developers and platform architects to groom solution designs align with best practices and business goals.
  + Validate proposed designs to ensure feasibility, scalability, and alignment with the broader ServiceNow architecture.
* Stakeholder and User Communication
  + Act as the primary liaison between stakeholders and technical teams, facilitating clear, ongoing communication.
  + Lead and facilitate workshops, discovery sessions, and stakeholder meetings to gather insights and define expectations.
  + Manage stakeholder expectations by clearly articulating platform capabilities, timelines, and constraints.
* Business Process Mapping and Optimization
  + Analyze and document current business processes (Journey Mapping) to identify inefficiencies and improvement opportunities.
  + Guide future-state processes that leverage ServiceNow capabilities to streamline operations and improve productivity.
  + Ensure alignment between redesigned processes and platform functionality and governance standards.
* ServiceNow Module Expertise
  + Maintain proficiency in core and advanced ServiceNow modules, such as ITSM, CSM, and others as needed.
  + Provide expert guidance on leveraging module capabilities and recommend enhancements or optimizations.
  + Stay current with ServiceNow developments to provide proactive recommendations aligned with platform innovation.
* Product Management Support
  + Assist with planning, scoping, scheduling, and tracking ServiceNow initiatives and deliverables.
  + Monitor project status, identify risks or roadblocks, and contribute to risk mitigation strategies and work with development teams to resolve.
  + Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and timely delivery of project components.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, or a related field; equivalent work experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* 6-9 years of experience as a Business Analyst, with a focus on supporting ServiceNow implementations and enhancements.
* Proven ability to gather, document, and manage business and functional requirements, including user stories, workflows, and use cases.
* Strong working knowledge of ServiceNow modules such as IT Service Management (ITSM), Customer Service Management (CSM), and others, with the ability to translate business needs into platform solutions.
* Demonstrated experience with business process mapping (e.g., journey mapping), process optimization, and aligning redesigned workflows with platform capabilities.
* Skilled in collaborating with cross-functional teams, including developers, architects, product owners, and project managers, to support successful solution delivery.
* Proficiency in Agile/Scrum methodologies, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and sprint execution cycles.
* Hands-on experience with Jira (or a comparable Agile project management tool) to manage requirements, user stories, and project tracking.
* Exceptional oral and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey technical and non-technical information to diverse audiences.
* Experience in facilitating workshops, stakeholder interviews, and discovery sessions to gather requirements and manage expectations.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

**Why Join Us:**

* Be part of a collaborative and innovative work environment.
* Opportunity for professional growth and development.
* Competitive salary and benefits package.

**Job Title: Product Sales Manager**

**Location: Hyderabad**

**Role Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Product Sales Manager to drive revenue growth across international markets through a consultative, solution-oriented selling approach. This role involves managing complex sales cycles, engaging with global customers, and working closely with cross-functional teams to position and sell technology products effectively. The ideal candidate will play a strategic role in expanding business, educating customers on product offerings, and closing high-value deals.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 5–7 years of experience in product sales within IT / technology solutions for international customers.
* Strong background in selling technology/AI products and managing end-to-end sales cycles.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Consultative Product Selling**

* Understand customer business needs and position products to address their challenges.
* Work closely with presales, product, and solution teams to create tailored product propositions.
* Educate customers on product capabilities, value proposition, and business impact, including AI-enabled and traditional technology solutions.

**2. Sales Cycle & Deal Management**

* Manage the complete sales lifecycle from lead generation to deal closure.
* Navigate complex sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, approvals, and technical evaluations.

* Actively engage with prospects and customers through meetings, presentations, and demos.

* Collaborate with presales, product, delivery, marketing, and operations teams to ensure seamless execution.

* Own and achieve quarterly and annual sales targets.
* Track pipeline, forecasts, and key sales metrics using CRM tools.

* Drive lead generation through outbound activities such as email campaigns, cold calling, and social selling.

jobs.description:
**Integrated Marketing Manager**

*Own the marketing calendar end-to-end — turn strategy into executed campaigns, on time, across every channel.*

**ROLE SUMMARY**

Cosmic Biotech is hiring an Integrated Marketing Manager to drive and coordinate execution across the marketing function. This role sits at the center of Growth, E-commerce, Content, Design, Trade, Website and Science, converting strategic direction into structured plans, timelines and deliverables, and ensuring campaigns and launches move from idea to market efficiently.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Build and manage the master marketing and launch calendar across all channels and teams.
* Translate brand, product and go-to-market strategy into actionable plans, timelines and deliverables.
* Coordinate execution across Growth, E-commerce, Content, Design, Trade, Website, Science and external partners.
* Manage launch readiness — track dependencies across teams and flag risks before they become delays.
* Track deliverables, timelines and execution status; maintain one reliable source of truth for progress.
* Coordinate external agencies, production partners and vendors, from brief through delivery.
* Consolidate reporting from marketing sub-functions into clear updates for management review.
* Track approved marketing budgets against planned and actual expenditure.
* Identify execution bottlenecks and drive them to resolution across teams and seniority levels.
* Ensure every campaign and launch moves from strategy to execution without dropped handoffs.

**REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

* Approximately 4–7 years of relevant marketing experience preferred, with broad exposure across brand, digital, content, trade and e-commerce. Exceptional candidates with fewer years but strong demonstrated judgement may also be considered.
* Demonstrated ability to build and run a launch calendar spanning multiple teams and dependencies.
* Strong judgement and prioritisation — able to determine what needs to happen, in what sequence, by when, and through whom.
* Experience coordinating external agencies and vendors, and tracking budgets against spend.
* Structured, organised communicator, able to consolidate scattered updates into clear reporting.
* MBA or formal business education preferred, not mandatory — decision-making ability matters more than credentials.
* Prior experience in pharma, nutraceutical, wellness or FMCG marketing is an advantage.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

We want a practical planner, not a candidate who reads well on paper alone. Shortlisted candidates should expect a practical launch-planning exercise as part of the interview process.

**LOGISTICS & COMPENSATION**

**Location**

Cosmic Biotech, Hyderabad (on-site)

Full-time

₹70,000 per month, based on experience

**Reporting To**

Founder / Management

**Priority**

Critical — immediate hiring need

* Flexible schedule

jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

The Retain Cloud Product Owner – Senior Associate is the dedicated product and platform owner for Retain Cloud, the firm’s resource planning and scheduling platform, within the Enterprise Applications Support team. Based in Crowe’s Hyderabad office and working closely with US-based stakeholders, this role combines hands-on administration and configuration with day-to-day product ownership: managing the Retain backlog and roadmap, translating business needs into well-defined epics and user stories, coordinating vendor releases, and driving adoption as additional business units move onto the platform.

This position takes Retain beyond break/fix support. The Product Owner partners with the Retain business owner, business unit resource management teams, the Solutions support team, and the Retain vendor to keep the platform stable, secure, and aligned with firm priorities. As Retain moves into steady-state operations, the role will also be cross-trained on other enterprise applications supported by the team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Ownership and Backlog Management:**

  

* Own the Retain Cloud product backlog in ServiceNow, capturing, refining, and prioritizing demands, epics, and user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
* Partner with the Retain business owner and business unit leaders to translate business goals into a product roadmap, release plan, and prioritized backlog.
* Lead requirements gathering and backlog refinement sessions, make day-to-day prioritization decisions, and escalate trade-offs that affect scope, timeline, or investment.
* Confirm that delivered changes meet the intended business need and are ready for release, coordinating user acceptance testing (UAT) with business users.
* Track adoption, data quality, and support trends to measure value and guide priorities.
* Platform Administration and Configuration
* Serve as the primary technical administrator for Retain Cloud, configuring security profiles, skills, scheduling units, booking components, dropdown values, and other system settings.
* Manage user access and role assignments through the ServiceNow access request process, and support periodic access reviews with business approvers.
* Prepare, run, and validate mass booking and other data loads in UAT and production.
* Monitor integrations and daily data feeds, including worker and skills data from Workday, and coordinate the resolution of feed and data issues.
* Maintain configuration documentation and follow the firm’s change management process.
* Release and Vendor Management
* Act as the primary liaison with the Retain vendor: log and track support cases, escalate defects, and monitor vendor SLA performance.
* Review vendor release notes, assess the impact of each Retain Cloud release, and plan and execute regression testing.
* Communicate upcoming releases, resolved issues, and new features to support teams and users, and confirm that incidents addressed in a release are closed afterward.
* Business Unit Onboarding and Adoption
* Lead configuration and readiness work for business units onboarding to Retain Cloud, including requirements, data migration and reconciliation, UAT, and cutover planning.
* oordinate the timing of changes and rollouts with business unit operations leaders to avoid busy season and filing-deadline conflicts.
* Develop training materials and job aids, and help resource managers adopt new features.
* Support and Continuous Improvement
* Serve as the Solutions-level (L3) escalation point for Retain incidents: reproduce issues in the test environment, capture diagnostics, manage problem records, and provide workarounds.
* Build and maintain the Retain knowledge base so Services and Troubleshooting teams can resolve common issues quickly and consistently.
* Analyze ticket trends to find recurring issues and drive permanent fixes or enhancements.
* Support Retain reporting needs by producing accurate scheduling and resource data for resource managers and leadership.

**Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 3–5 years of experience in enterprise SaaS application administration, business systems analysis, or product ownership.
* At least 2 years of hands-on experience administering, configuring, or supporting Retain (Retain Cloud strongly preferred); deep experience with a comparable resource management platform will be considered.
* Experience supporting resource management or scheduling teams in a professional services environment (audit, tax, or consulting) preferred.
* Experience managing a backlog and writing epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria in ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, Jira, or a similar tool.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow ITSM and ITIL practices.
* Experience with Workday or other HR system integrations and data loads is a plus.
* Product Owner certification (such as CSPO or PSPO) preferred.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and SharePoint.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Customer Service (CS) is a large and global organization, obsessed with taking care of our customers and delivering reliably fast, convenient, and helpful support when they need it. Whether customers interact with our self-serve solutions or CS Associates, we work hard to make sure they have a delightful experience with us, each and every time.  
  
We are looking for a customer-obsessed product leader to join us as a leader for the Dynamic Andon Response Team (DART) org within Customer Service. You will lead our team of program managers, product managers, quality managers and business analysts who dig deep into peer-to-peer consultation and customer escalations, trace it back to its source, and drive upstream and downstream product and programmatic improvements to DART Usage. Your teams will own the roadmap of DART strategic initiatives primarily focused on technical solutions to eliminate wasteful usage for DART and enhance CX for DART escalations.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The role requires someone who can use significant expertise and high judgment to distill diverse inputs from customers, DART specialists and stakeholders to set a vision and design the right long-term solutions. You will spend your time analyzing customer friction data to identify the biggest opportunities and building compelling cases for improvements. This means diving deep into significantly complex problems where defects create friction across multiple parts of the customer journey. You will work across multiple organizations and leadership to influence and achieve consensus on priorities.  
  
You will partner on product and technology solutions within and outside the Amazon Customer Service org to drive high impact innovation and improvements that can transform the service experience we offer to our customers.
  
Your teams will create mechanisms that make defect elimination sustainable. This includes building dashboards and tools that show customer impact, designing processes that catch problems before they reach customers, and establishing metrics that keep everyone focused on goals. You will be regularly working at both tactical and strategic levels to deliver results.
  
  
This is the right role for you if:  

* You can handle significantly complex problems and efforts, with the ability to see both visible and not-yet-visible risks.
* You excel at taking complex technical problems and explaining them clearly to drive consensus among stakeholders.
* You can work strategically to determine where resources are best applied while actively working to remove bottlenecks.
* You create scalable mechanisms and best practices while effectively influencing and force multiplying across organizations.
* You have deep customer obsession and can translate that into measurable improvements in customer experience.
* Lead multiple teams to improve customer experience by proactively identifying and eliminating sources of customer escalations and associate consult contacts.
* Own the DART Usage Rate improvement vision and create scalable mechanisms to drive organizational change.
* Establish data-driven approaches to surface customer pain points and drive upstream action across organizations.
* Influence senior leaders to prioritize and address systemic customer experience issues causing escalations through high-quality analytics and communication.
* Advocate for customers in product, design, and operational decisions across organizations.
* Deliver measurable outcomes aligned with organizational goals.
* Write and present clear narratives to drive alignment and decision-making.
* Coach and develop high-performing teams while creating leadership opportunities.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 6+ years of team management experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience delivering consumer software products and services in a high growth environment

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. We believe in empowering consultants to take ownership, learn continuously, and drive innovation in how healthcare data is used to inform business and patient care decisions.

**About the role:**
At Acuitas360, we are seeking data enthusiasts to join our team as a Senior Business Analyst, focusing on data analytics, business intelligence, and sales force effectiveness. This is a role based in Hyderabad, offering the opportunity to collaborate with global clients and cross-functional teams across Acuitas360.

**Why Join Us?**

Here’s why Acuitas360 is the perfect place to start your professional journey:

• A Collaborative ONE TEAM Culture: We are a tight-knit team fueled by high energy, enthusiasm, and a shared passion for our work. You will be welcomed into an environment where collaboration and enjoyment are part of daily life.

• Performance-Driven Environment: At Acuitas360, your efforts are valued. We are invested in your all-round development, offering opportunities to grow as you build your career.

• Innovation at the Core: We encourage creativity and forward-thinking, empowering even newcomers to tackle challenges with innovative solutions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Analyze life sciences data, including sales, physician, patient, and prescription data, to deliver insights for commercial analytics, sales force effectiveness, and business intelligence projects.
* Develop, maintain, and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources.
* Use Python and Excel/VBA to automate recurring analytical tasks, perform data manipulation, and improve process efficiency.
* Develop reports, dashboards, and presentations using Power BI, Tableau, PowerPoint, and Excel to communicate analytical findings and business insights effectively.
* Translate business requirements into analytical solutions by collaborating with cross-functional teams, including data engineers, business stakeholders, and life sciences domain experts.
* Take ownership of assigned analytical workstreams, ensuring data accuracy, timely delivery, and adherence to project requirements and quality standards.
* Perform data validation, troubleshoot discrepancies, investigate issues, and recommend solutions to improve analytical outputs and reporting processes.
* Contribute to project documentation, process standardization, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Present findings and communicate project progress, risks, and dependencies clearly to internal teams and stakeholders.

**What You Will Bring**

**• Experience:**
2–3 years of relevant experience in data analytics, business intelligence, commercial analytics, or a related field. Experience in life sciences or pharmaceutical analytics is preferred.

•
**Educational Background:**
Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, MBA, MSc, pharmacy, statistics, or another quantitative discipline.

•
**Technical Skills:**
Hands-on proficiency in SQL and Excel, with working knowledge of Python and/or Excel VBA. Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau is an advantage.

•
**Data Analytics:**
Experience working with structured datasets, performing data transformations, conducting exploratory analysis, validating outputs, and identifying meaningful trends and insights.

•
**Business Acumen:**
Ability to understand business requirements, translate them into analytical approaches, and connect data-driven findings to business objectives.

•
**Problem-Solving:**
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, attention to detail, and the ability to investigate complex data issues independently.

•
**Communication:**
Ability to explain analytical findings, prepare clear presentations, document processes, and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

•
**Ownership and Execution:**
Ability to manage assigned tasks with minimal supervision, prioritize competing deliverables, meet deadlines, and proactively flag risks or dependencies.

•

Hiver is a modern, AI-driven customer service platform used by companies across healthcare, finance, logistics, education, and technology. We help teams deliver fast, human support across email, chat, phone, WhatsApp, and more, without the complexity of legacy helpdesks.

If you want meaningful ownership, thoughtful teammates, and work that ships, Hiver is a great place to do it.

**About the role**

We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager who can turn product capabilities into clear stories, successful launches, and sustained adoption.

You’ll own how we take new features to market, help sales communicate our value, turn customer outcomes into compelling stories, and help customers get more from Hiver. * **Product and feature launches:** Lead launches from planning through execution. Define the audience, positioning, messaging, launch assets, and distribution plan. Align teams on readiness and measure results beyond launch day.

* **Customer and competitive insights:** Speak with customers, review sales conversations, study competitors, and understand why we win or lose. Use those insights to improve messaging, launches, and enablement.
* **Product storytelling across channels:** Develop product pages, launch announcements, demo scripts, videos, and campaign narratives. Keep the story clear and consistent wherever prospects and customers encounter Hiver.

  

### **Key Requirements**

* 7–10 years of relevant experience, with substantial experience in product marketing at a B2B SaaS company.

* Curiosity about AI and how it changes the way businesses serve customers. Experience in customer service software or related categories is a plus.

Customers understand why new capabilities matter and put them to use. Sales has a clear, credible story and the proof to support it. Launches generate qualified interest and adoption. Customer insights consistently shape how we position, communicate, and take Hiver to market.

### **About Hiver**

We specialise in delivering innovative solutions and exceptional services to meet the diverse needs of our clients. With a strong commitment to quality and customer satisfaction, we strive to exceed expectations and drive success in every project we undertake.

jobs.description:
Overview:

Our Business Analyst plays a vital role as the "glue" in our project/task team. As our primary inhouse  
client advocate, the Business Analyst works closely with the stakeholders, technical  
team, and SMEs to lead and facilitate discussions to understand the client's needs, ask clarifying  
questions, discuss alternative scenarios, and turn them into requirements. Once the  
requirements are captured, the Business Analyst will work closely with our technical team  
(product owners, project manager, development manager, and technical lead) to help design  
and develop a solution to meet the client's requirements. Throughout the project's life, the  
Business Analyst's primary responsibility is representing the client and ensuring all deliverables  
align with the project's vision. This involves working with virtually every member of the project  
team, both internal and client-facing, to facilitate communication, review the quality of  
deliverables, and ensure project success.

To be successful as a Business Analyst, you should be a self-driven and curious person with  
great attention to detail. Since the Business Analyst role is the "glue" for all projects, strong  
verbal and written communication skills are a priority, has the ability to work with a vast array  
of project team members. More importantly, one must have and interest in problem-solving, a  
positive attitude, and a willingness to learn. Ultimately, working as a Business Analyst, you will  
learn to quickly break down and understand varying business processes, help to identify gaps or  
areas for improvement in those processes, and then translate those into requirements via  
visual and written documentation. Because our clients span a wide range of internal  
organizational styles, no two projects are the same, and Analyst bridges the gap between  
operational and technical resources. Our Business Analysts should be able to follow our  
standard project processes and adjust those processes on the fly to meet the needs of the  
client or project.

Responsibilities:

Assist the Business Analyst team in working with the client to:  

* Assess, research, analyze and document sponsor/stakeholder/request needs.
* Identify and diagnose business problems and potential solutions.
* Develop and maintain project documentation related to the business requirements (for

example, User requirements, use cases, wireframes, process flows, site maps, etc.)  

* Develop and maintain a strong relationship with internal/external team members.
* Identify issues in a project and escalate/manage resolution as required.
* Coordinate and provide support to the business with the process implementation.
* Advocate for clients during Sprint cycles to govern workstreams, compliance to

requirements, and ensure timelines.  

* Assist with organizing UAT structure, testing, goals, and results.
* Provide timely updates and communication to entire project/task team.

Work with our internal project team to:  

* Represent the client in all aspects of a project.
* Support the team in planning, development, stabilization, and deployment of user

requirements to the overall workflow.  

* Support the team in identifying potential solutions, roadblocks, and issues.
* Review user requirements with the technical team at the start of the project to ensure

they understand the project requirements  

* Identify and escalate gaps in the proposed solution to ensure we are meeting all client

requirements.  

* Check-in with the support development team to answer any questions and help clear

roadblocks.  

* Perform quality assurance testing on all deliverables before releasing them to the client.
* Provide knowledge transfer and training as needed to assist with the transition to other

internal teams.  

* Audit and improve internal processes as needed.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree or related work experience  

* 4+ years experience as a Business Analyst or similar role
* Experience using Jira or equivalent software planning system
* Assess, research, analyze and document sponsor/stakeholder/requester needs
* General understanding of Agile and Sprint organization and planning
* Develop and maintain project documentation related to the business requirements (for

example, User requirements, use cases, wireframes, process flows, modeling, etc.)  

* Experience in process design, including developing and executing process improvements
* Experience with Replicon, a plus

Other Requirements:  

* Project Management experience and knowledge desired
* Experience in eDiscovery not required but preferred
* Experience and knowledge with coding and SQL queries a plus
* Knowledge of software development life cycle (SDLC) methodologies; programming logic and work-flow concepts; and test planning, coordination and execution
* Proficient in Microsoft Suite of Products (Power BI, Excel, OneNote, Teams, etc.)

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About Metaforms**
-------------------

Metaforms is a vertically integrated AI SaaS platform for market research agencies around the world. The platform helps agencies improve speed, consistency, and delivery quality across research workflows that have historically depended on repetitive manual effort and hard-to-scale specialist knowledge.

The product surface is unusual. Surveys behave like programs, business workflows contain hidden operational nuance, and a small mistake can create real downstream cost for an agency and its clients. That means product thinking here is not about copying familiar SaaS patterns. It is about understanding how work is actually done, identifying where AI agents can reliably help, and shaping systems that feel intuitive to users while introducing genuinely new workflows underneath.

**The Role**
------------

As our first Technical Project Manager, you'll own how complex work gets shipped at Metaforms. Product decides what to build and engineering decides how; you make sure it lands on time, at the right quality, with nothing falling between teams.

You'll run cross-functional programs spanning engineering, AI/ML, product, and customer success, including enterprise customer rollouts. Success in this role means leadership trusts your delivery dates, engineers see you as a force multiplier rather than overhead, and customers go live without surprises.

* Location: Bengaluru, on-site
* Reports to: Head of Product
* Experience: 4 - 6 years

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own end-to-end delivery of cross-team initiatives: break them into milestones, map dependencies, and drive them to launch
* Run the delivery cadence with engineering and product: cycle planning support, risk tracking, decision logs, and weekly status for leadership
* Coordinate AI feature delivery where timelines depend on model quality, keeping evals, quality benchmarks and ship/no-ship criteria visible alongside engineering progress
* Bring market research domain experts into the build loop so their definition of a good output shapes what we ship
* Lead enterprise customer implementations with Customer Success: pilots, data onboarding, integrations, security reviews and go-live plans
* Turn recurring customer asks and implementation pain into clear inputs for the product roadmap
* Spot when an estimate is unrealistic or two teams are building conflicting things, and resolve it early

**What we are looking for**
---------------------------

* 4–6 years across technical program management, engineering, solutions engineering or implementation, with at least 2 years owning cross-team delivery
* A track record of shipping software products to enterprise B2B customers
* Enough technical depth to discuss architecture, APIs and data pipelines credibly with engineers and challenge estimates
* Experience managing work with uncertain timelines, ideally ML or data-heavy products where quality is measured, not assumed
* Comfort in customer-facing settings, including running implementation calls and managing delivery commitments with US-based clients
* Clear, concise written communication: status updates, plans and trade-off docs that leadership can act on
* A bias for action and comfort with ambiguity in an early-stage, fast-changing environment

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Hands-on experience with LLM-powered products: evals, prompt iteration, or working alongside ML engineers
* Background in or exposure to market research, survey platforms, analytics or insights tooling
* Experience as an early TPM or program owner at a Series A-C startup
* A prior engineering role, so you've felt the other side of the delivery plan

**Why Metaforms**
-----------------

* A real apprenticeship into product management close mentorship from senior PMs and senior engineers, not a sink-or-swim first job.
* Work on AI products that operate in real production environments, not demos or feature theater.
* Join a team where product, engineering, and domain understanding are tightly coupled.
* Visible, real work from day one your notes, write-ups, and small feature areas genuinely shape what gets built.
* Join a Series A funded company at the steepest part of its growth curve.

jobs.title: APM - toolkits
jobs.description:
**Who are we?**
---------------

Composio builds the AI-native automation layer for software teams: SDKs, runtimes, and platform tooling that let developers compose, evaluate, and operate agentic workflows and AI-powered products. Our systems must be reliable at scale - agents must act correctly, integrations must be robust, and integration needs to be an autonomous, observable function that accelerates engineering rather than slowing it. You'll join a small, high-leverage team building the delivery systems and metrics that give product and support teams visibility and predictable delivery.

This role is based in Bangalore (HSR).

**Who is our ideal candidate?**
-------------------------------

A high-agency operator who is also AI-native, and who wants to grow into product. The role starts ops-heavy: you run the operations that get apps live on Composio, keep the toolkits healthy, and automate as much of that work as you can. Over 6-8 months, once those workflows and automations are running, the role shifts towards owning ambiguous product problems across the platform - triggers, tools, skills, auth, governance, and toolkit-level issues like rate limits and MCP hosting. This is not a traditional PM role with an engineering team to direct. It's closer to founder-mode ownership of a product line, where you solve problems using agents and a small ops team.

You've shipped things on your own - a side project, a tool, a micro-business, or a system you built that is still running - and you've run real operations with quality bars, not just executed inside someone else's process. You're at the edge of AI out of genuine curiosity: you use AI tools daily and can point to specific things you built or automated with them in the last month. You pick work by impact, not by how interesting it is, and you have no ego about manual work that isn't automated yet. You can hold a technical conversation with engineers without a translator, and you're comfortable owning problems that don't have a clear owner yet.

**What will they own?**
-----------------------

* The toolkit number: how many apps are live on Composio, and the health of the ones already live.
* New apps, end to end: run the operations of getting them live - research, setup, QA, launch.
* Existing toolkits: make them better with the product team, and clear the issues that stop them from working well.
* QA and support for every toolkit you bring live. Once it's live, its quality is your problem.
* The ops playbook: build it, run it, scale it. SOPs, small tools, AI agents before humans - you automate yourself first, and when scaling takes people, hiring them is part of the job.
* The metrics for this function: define them, build them, watch them.
* Product problems, as the ops layer starts running on its own: ambiguous, non-engineering problems across triggers, tools, auth, governance and toolkit-level issues - scoped, owned and shipped by you.

**What are we looking for?**
----------------------------

* Experience: 2-4 years. We care more about how fast you've grown than how senior you are.
* Technical floor: can explain what an API and an integration are, reads API docs cold, writes enough code to build small tools and automations. Not an engineer; infra-level work is not the job.
* AI-native automation instinct: your default answer to repeated work is "how do I never do this manually again" - backed by recent, specific evidence of things you've built or automated with AI.
* Dirty-work appetite: you happily run the manual version today while the automation is being built. This and the automation instinct are both required; we never average them.
* Process maturity: you've designed or owned a pipeline with throughput, SLAs, or quality bars, and you left systems running behind you - not just stories.
* Product instinct: you can take a vague problem, figure out what's actually broken, and decide what to build or fix - without waiting for a spec or a dedicated engineering team.
* Organized ownership: routines, follow-ups, nothing dropped. You communicate clearly, in writing and in person.
* High agency in uncertainty: given a goal with no playbook and no owner above you, you define the problem yourself and start before permission.
* Operating maturity: this role carries a number from week one, so it needs someone who has owned outcomes before. It is not internship-shaped.

We'll pass at any stage on candidates who only want the cool parts of the job, choose work by interestingness over impact, can't explain what an API is, or do the same manual work in month three as month one.

**Nice-to-have**
----------------

* Founder or early-stage experience: you've taken something from zero, or joined early and owned a function.
* Experience with SaaS integrations, API products, or developer-facing products.
* Built things with agents or LLM workflows beyond personal use - tools, experiment logs, side projects other people use.
* An engineering-adjacent path: studied engineering and moved into non-technical work, or a non-CS background with things you built on the side.
* High-throughput ops backgrounds (delivery, marketplace, physical ops) count only alongside the AI-native bar above - on their own they are not this job.

**Outcomes we expect in the first 90 days**
-------------------------------------------

* More toolkits live on Composio - you own the supply number, and it moved.
* Existing toolkits repaired or unblocked without anything breaking technically.
* A v1 ops playbook running: SOPs, automations, and AI agents handling the repeatable parts of onboarding and QA.
* Metrics for the function defined and visible: supply, health of supply, pipeline status.
* What this is not: usage. Usage is a product metric; this role is measured on supply and the health of supply.

**Overall job purpose:**

We are seeking a highly skilled **Business Analyst** with deep expertise in the **U.S. Property & Casualty (P&C) commercial insurance** ecosystem. In this role, you will act as the vital bridge between business stakeholders and technology teams. You will drive the design, optimization, and implementation of end-to-end insurance systems, workflows crossing **Wholesale Brokers, Managing General Agents (MGAs), and Insurance Carriers**.

The ideal candidate possesses a holistic understanding of how risk moves from an agent’s hands through wholesale channels, gets underwritten by MGAs, and is ultimately bound and managed on a Carrier’s paper.

**Main responsibilities:**

**Business Requirements & Process Mapping**

* **Translate complex P&C insurance workflows** into clear business requirements (BRDs), functional specifications (FRDs), user stories, and process maps.
* Document end-to-end Commercial Lines lifecycles (New Business, Renewals, Endorsements, Cancellations) across multiple lines of business (e.g., General Liability, Commercial Property, Excess & Surplus, Inland Marine, Commercial & Personal Auto etc).

**Submission Management Optimization**

* Analyze and optimize the **Submission Management pipeline**, focusing on reducing clearance times and improving data ingestion from multi-channel sources (emails, portals, ACORD forms, API feeds).
* Define requirements for **Intelligent Document Processing (IDP)**, OCR solutions, or submission triage tools to automate data extraction from ACORD 125/126/140 etc., forms and supplemental applications.

**Value Chain Integration (Broker** **➔ MGA** **➔ Carrier)**

* **Wholesale Broker Workflows:** Map how wholesale brokers aggregate risks, market them to multiple markets, and manage quote comparisons.

**MGA Operations:** Design solutions for MGAs utilizing delegated underwriting authority, managing program business, and enforcing carrier-defined underwriting guidelines and rate/rule/form structures.

**Carrier Core Systems:** Ensure seamless data transmission to Carrier core systems for risk aggregation, policy issuance, billing, and regulatory reporting (statutory coding).

**System & Data Integration**

Facilitate automated bordereau reporting structures between MGAs and Carriers, ensuring financial and statistical data integrity.

Collaborate with architectural teams to define API integration requirements connecting modern front-end portals, rating engines (ISO or proprietary), and back-office policy administration systems (PAS).

**Qualifications, Work experience:**

* **Experience:** Minimum **5–7 years of Business Analysis experience** strictly within the **U.S. P&C Insurance industry**.
* **Domain Knowledge:** Holistic understanding of the commercial insurance distribution model, including the distinct roles and interactions of **Wholesale Brokers, MGAs, and Carriers**.
* **Technical Familiarity:**
  + Strong familiarity with insurance core systems (e.g., Guidewire, Duck Creek, Origami Risk) or specialized MGA/Broker platforms (e.g., Vertafore, Applied Systems, Novidea).
  + Hands-on experience with **ACORD data standards** and forms.
  + Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies, writing Jira user stories, and managing backlogs.

**Analytical Skills:** Proficiency in SQL for data mapping and validation, as well as business process mapping tools (e.g., Lucidchart, Visio).

* Professional insurance designations such as **CPCU (Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter)** or **AU (Associate in Commercial Underwriting)**.

Experience with **Excess & Surplus (E&S) lines** and non-admitted market workflows.

Excellent written and oral communication skills, Excellent Documentation Skills

**Note: US P&C Commercial claim insurance hands on mandatory**

**Location: Bangalore**

**Mode of Work: Work from Office**

**Experience: 5-7 years**

**Role**: HR Process & Data Analyst / TA Data Analyst

**Location**: Bengaluru, Karnataka (On-site )

**Experience**: 5 to 8 Years overall (Minimum 23 years in HR/TA Data Analytics)

**Employment Type**: Full-Time

### **About the Opportunity**

We are looking for a sharp, data-driven **HR Process & Data Analyst** to transform raw talent acquisition and workforce data into actionable business intelligence. In this role, you will own recruitment analytics, build interactive dashboards, automate reporting workflows, and help drive data-backed decisions to optimize our client's global hiring and operations.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Data Extraction & Management**: Collect, clean, and validate data across ATS, HRIS, MS Excel trackers, and applicant surveys to ensure maximum data integrity.
* **Dashboards & Visualization**: Design, build, and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards and visual executive reports.
* **Process Automation**: Write MS Excel Macros/VBA to automate daily/weekly/monthly HR metrics and reporting workflows.
* **Predictive Insights**: Conduct statistical analysis (trends, correlations, forecasting) to spot hiring pipeline bottlenecks, risks, and vendor performance patterns.
* **Vendor & Operations Support**: Validate monthly vendor invoices, track agency SLAs, and support HR compliance, audits, and data privacy standard execution.

### **Key Qualifications & Skills**

* **Experience**: 58 years total experience with **2+ years explicitly focused on HR/TA data analysis**.
* **Technical Stack**: High proficiency in **MS Excel (Advanced formulas & Macros)**, **Power BI**, and **SQL**. (Exposure to Python or R is a plus).
* **Domain Knowledge**: Solid understanding of ATS/HRIS data structures and key recruitment metrics (e.g., Time-to-Fill, Cost-per-Hire, Source Mix).
* **Analytical Mindset**: Strong grasp of statistical analysis techniques, data auditing, and anomaly detection.
* **Communication**: Ability to translate complex data sets into simple, compelling visual stories for cross-functional stakeholders.

### **What's in It for You?**

* Direct ownership of core analytics and automation projects.
* High-impact exposure to cross-border global talent operations.
* Dynamic, fast-paced work environment with ample growth potential.

jobs.description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**




Join Novonesis as a Senior AI Data Analyst and help advance how AI is applied to data and analytics across our global organization. As part of Data & AI Enablement within the Data Office in Global IT, you will work with specialists across India and Denmark to evolve our Citizen Data Platform and help business teams create value from data and emerging AI capabilities.
  
  
**The role & your impact**  
You will help translate our AI-enabled direction for the Citizen Data Platform into practical solutions and adoption activities, making advanced analytics and AI capabilities more accessible to business users across Novonesis. You will support conversational analytics experiences such as Copilot in Power BI and Fabric Data Agents, advise teams on effective uses of AI within analytics, and help turn successful solutions into reusable assets and best practices that can scale across the organization.
  
  
**Your key responsibilities in this role**

* Contribute to the development and delivery of our AI-enabled direction for the Citizen Data Platform.
* Support adoption of conversational analytics by engaging with business teams and providing practical guidance and strategic direction.
* Assess market trends and identify opportunities where AI can simplify access to data and insights.
* Enable and support users on the Citizen Data Platform through training programmes, drop-in support sessions, community engagement, and support handling.
* Contribute to governance standards and best practices for AI-enabled analytics, while helping maintain reporting that tracks usage, platform health, and compliance.
Collaborate with platform teams, architects, AI specialists, legal, and security teams to guide use cases toward appropriate solutions and ensure alignment with established governance, compliance, and security requirements.  

**What you'll need to be successful in this role**

* 5+ years of experience within analytics, business intelligence, data platforms, AI enablement, consulting, or related disciplines.
* Strong understanding of analytics platforms such as Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, KNIME, or similar citizen developer technologies.
* Strong stakeholder engagement and facilitation capabilities.
* Experience driving enablement, adoption, or organizational change initiatives.
Experience planning and delivering projects or workstreams involving multiple stakeholders.  

**Additional skills & interests we value**

* Experience working with generative AI or conversational agents.
* Curiosity about emerging AI technologies and an ability to translate new capabilities into practical business value.
* An interest in how AI can transform traditional analytics capabilities and ways of working.
A structured approach and the ability to connect business needs with technical solutions in an evolving environment.  

**What we offer you**  
You will join a highly collaborative Data & AI Enablement team with specialists in India and Denmark and work with stakeholders and initiatives spanning the value chain. The role gives you the opportunity to contribute to the evolution of the Citizen Data Platform, support a strong citizen developer community, and help scale AI-enabled analytics capabilities across Novonesis.
  
  
**Working conditions**  
The position is based in Bangalore and follows a hybrid working setup. The role includes occasional travel as we scale capabilities and enablement globally across Novonesis.
  
  
**Application deadline**  
October 20, 2026.

**Our purpose guides the way**

In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.

**Opportunities for everyone**

We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.

We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.

**Explore other openings**

If this position isn’t the right fit, you may still find other opportunities with us. You’re welcome to explore open roles or create a job agent to stay connected with future opportunities at novonesis.com/Career
